Fixes #7.

## Problem
`refresh()` in `src/auth.js` called itself with the same expired session, so it never returned and the page froze.

## Change
- Return the session unchanged when it is still valid.
- When it has expired, call `fetchSession()` once and return its result.
- `fetchSession` is now a parameter. It is not defined anywhere in this repo, so the function no longer depends on a name that doesn't exist here.

## Open question for the reviewer

EOF
